title: Source
description: Where this service's code or image comes from. Saving doesn't touch what's running: deploy to apply it.
savedHint: It takes effect at the next deploy.
imageHint: From any registry, for example ghcr.io/owner/app:1.2.
passwordStored: A password is stored for this image's repository. Leave this blank to keep it, or clear the username to remove both. Moving to another repository takes the password again.
branchHint: A branch, a tag or a full commit hash.
pathHint: The folder to build from. Useful in a monorepo.

git.urlHint: An https:// or ssh:// address, or user@host:path.

github.tokenWarning: Private repositories need a GitHub token.

dockerfile.label: Dockerfile
dockerfile.hint: Built as it is, with nothing else in its context.

upload.drop: Drop an archive of your code here, or choose a file
upload.formats: zip, tar, tar.gz, tar.bz2, tar.xz, tar.zst, 7z or rar, up to {{limit}}

build.title: Build
build.description: How the code becomes an image. With nothing chosen, a Dockerfile in the build path is used if there is one, and Nixpacks otherwise.
build.savedHint: They take effect at the next build.
build.skippedHint: The next build detects what to use.

descriptions.dockerfile: Build from a Dockerfile in the repository.
descriptions.buildpacks: Detect the stack and build it with a Cloud Native Buildpacks builder.
descriptions.nixpacks: Detect the stack and build it with Nixpacks.
descriptions.railpack: Detect the stack and build it with Railpack.

build.fileHint: Relative to the build path, which is also the Docker context.
build.builderHint: Any builder image, pinned to a full release or a digest so that it can't change under a service.
build.commandHint: Set a command to replace the detected one.
build.misePackagesHint: Separated by spaces, as name or name@version.
build.deployAptPackages: APT packages in the final image

facts.versionDockerfile: BuildKit, in this server's own Docker
facts.anyLanguage: Any: the Dockerfile says how to build it

overridesBy.dockerfile: The Dockerfile's path. The rest is in the file itself, and its build variables and secrets come from the Environment tab.
overridesBy.buildpacks: The builder image, and a project.toml in the build path.
overridesBy.nixpacks: The install, build and start commands, Nix and APT packages, and a nixpacks.toml in the build path.
overridesBy.railpack: The install, build and start commands, Mise and APT packages, and a railpack.json in the build path.

failsBy.dockerfile: A step that fails, a base image that can't be fetched or a missing Dockerfile fails the deployment. What is running is left alone.
failsBy.buildpacks: A project none of its buildpacks recognise fails the deployment and says so. What is running is left alone.
failsBy.nixpacks: A version that is not installed, or a project it can't work out how to build, fails the deployment and says so. What is running is left alone.
failsBy.railpack: A version that is not installed, or a project it can't work out how to build, fails the deployment and says so. What is running is left alone.

build.versionHint: Which release of the builder to run.

sshKey.title: SSH key
sshKey.description: A private repository needs a key. Generate one, then add its public half to the repository on your Git host, as a read-only deploy key.
sshKey.generatedHint: Add its public half to your Git host.
sshKey.refreshDescription: The current key stops working for this service at once, so add the new one to your Git host before the next deploy.
sshKey.notBound: Not tied to a repository yet: the first one it is used for claims it.
sshKey.testOk: Connected: this key can read the repository.
sshKey.deleteDescription: Opsifier forgets the key at once and stops using it. It is still installed at your Git host: remove it there to revoke it fully.
sshKey.deletedHint: Remove it from your Git host as well.

autoDeploy.title: Auto-deploy
autoDeploy.label: Deploy on every push to {{branch}}
autoDeploy.hint: Adds a webhook to the repository. The GitHub token needs permission to manage webhooks.
autoDeploy.pausedTitle: The webhook is paused because the branch changed. Renew it to resume.
autoDeploy.legacyHook: This webhook dates from before webhooks had a secret of their own. Renew it to give it one.

errors.imageInvalid: Enter an image such as name:tag.
errors.refRequired: Enter a branch, tag or commit.
errors.refInvalid: That isn't a branch, tag or commit name git would accept.
errors.urlRequired: Enter the address of the repository.
errors.urlInvalid: Use an https:// or ssh:// address, or user@host:path.
errors.pathRequired: Enter a folder, or / for the whole repository.
errors.pathInvalid: Use a folder inside the repository, such as /apps/web.
errors.fileType: Use a zip, tar, 7z or rar archive.

build.file: Use a path inside the build path, such as Dockerfile.
build.builder: Use a builder image pinned to a full release such as 0.4.681, or to a digest.
build.installCommand: Write the command on one line.
build.buildCommand: Write the command on one line.
build.startCommand: Write the command on one line.
build.nixPackages: Use package names separated by spaces.
build.aptPackages: Use package names separated by spaces.
build.misePackages: Use name or name@version, separated by spaces.
build.buildAptPackages: Use package names separated by spaces.
build.deployAptPackages: Use package names separated by spaces.

changeRevokes: Saving another repository or branch revokes this service's deployment token and pauses its webhook, because they were issued for this one.
